::: {#def-statistical-model .theorem}
## Statistical model

A collection of probability distributions $\mathcal M$ on a vector of [random variables](#def-random-variable) $\mathbf V$, indexed by a parameter $\theta$.

$$
\mathcal{M}=\{P_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}\quad\text{on the random variables }\mathbf V.
$$
:::
